definitions.full: H6396. Pallu מַּלּוּא proper name, masculine (DHM Epigr. Denkm. 9, 1 compare Lihyanian proper name פלה ); — son of Reuben Gen 46:9 ; Exod 6:14 ; Num 26:5 , 8 ; 1Chr 5:3 , Φαλλου ( ς ), etc.; see also מֶּלֶת .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
